localization_rule: After freeze, if the public issue body explicitly names source file paths, candidate generation may be restricted to those named paths; otherwise use all eligible non-test Rust source.
memory_order: stable sort by retained operator score descending, then frozen generator order
pass_rule: Frozen baseline reproduces the issue; a candidate generated with zero external-model calls passes the frozen objective and regressions; winning operator is integer_delta; exact replay passes.
transfer_rule: A positive Rust result using the same retained integer_delta strategy, together with prior JavaScript A2 and Python A3 evidence, establishes the three-language A5 DEVELOPMENT threshold.
claim_boundary: A5 DEVELOPMENT only; this is a language-family transfer test, not general software autonomy.
